article.title: India Becomes World's 3rd Largest Economy — GDP Surpasses Japan
article.description: India's GDP crossed $5.1 trillion, surpassing Japan and making India the world's third-largest economy. The IMF attributes this to manufacturing growth, the digital economy, and a 7%+ growth rate fueled by the demographic dividend.
article.author: Dr. Raghuram Rajan

article.title: NEP 2.0 Makes AI and Coding Mandatory from Class 6 Onwards
article.description: The National Education Policy 2.0 mandates AI, Coding, and Robotics as core subjects from Class 6, introduces a 5+3+3+4 academic structure, and replaces rote learning with competency-based assessments.
article.author: Dharmendra Pradhan

article.title: Vande Bharat Express Network Crosses 500 Routes Pan-India
article.description: Indian Railways flagged off its 500th Vande Bharat route, connecting every state capital. The 350-train fleet at 160 km/h has cut average inter-city travel time by 40%, serving 2 million monthly passengers.
article.author: Ashwini Vaishnaw

article.title: India's Startup Ecosystem Hits 1.5 Lakh Startups — World No. 2
article.description: India's startup ecosystem crossed 1.5 lakh DPIIT-registered startups with 112 unicorns valued at $350 billion, making it the world's second-largest startup hub behind only the USA.
article.author: Piyush Goyal

article.title: Ayushman Bharat 2.0 Extends Free Healthcare to 70 Crore Citizens
article.description: The Union Cabinet expanded Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY to 70 crore citizens with Rs 10 lakh annual coverage per family, now including mental health, dental, and vision care for the first time.
article.author: Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya
